text:
samir: Heads-up — rolling out additional audit events for KMS ops and RBAC actor role changes in schema v2.1 tomorrow. Need a customer-preview package + changelog. Who can own sample events + mapping doc?

elaine: I can own the sample pack. Quick q: do we include both key_id and key_alias in events?

mike: RBAC change: we standardize actor.role values for service accounts to `service_account` namespace; this will affect downstream parsers. Plan to add `actor.role_source` to avoid breakage.

judy: For KMS, customers asked for alias in plaintext (eg `rdw-prod-key`). Privacy thought: is alias sensitive? @legal take?

legal: quick read — alias is fine if it's not PII. If alias contains customer IDs, mask in sample. Prefer both id+alias with guidance.

samir: ok plan: include `resource.key_id` and `resource.key_alias`. Mask alias in samples where needed. Draft event example:

```json
{ "event_type": "kms.key.rotate", "ts": "2026-03-15T12:05:00Z", "actor": { "id": "svc-123", "type": "service_account", "role": "inference-runner" }, "resource": { "id": "key-abc", "alias": "projects/acme/keys/rdw-key" }, "outcome": "success", "metadata": { "kms_request_id": "req-789", "region": "us-west1" } }
```

elaine: perfect — I'll include that in the sample pack with masked alias variants.

mike: validation plan: 1) unit tests against schema (jsonschema) 2) run our sample pack through customer parsers (3 pilot customers) 3) backfill mapping docs and changelog. Anyone want to draft the customer-facing email?

judy: I can draft the email. Keep it short: what's changing, impact (parsers), example events, rollback path, support contact.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: staging -> prod on 2026-03-16 02:00 UTC :rocket:

audit-bot: New audit hook registered: `kms.ops.v2` — samples saved to internal S3:/audit-preview/kms-v2/

samir: Action items:
- elaine -> sample pack + masked examples (due 2026-03-15 18:00 UTC)
- judy -> customer email draft + changelog blurb (due 2026-03-15 20:00 UTC)
- mike -> jsonschema bump + unit tests (due 2026-03-15 17:00 UTC)
- legal -> quick review on alias guidance (ASAP)
- ops -> ensure preview logs accessible to pilots

elaine: noted :eyes:

judy: will ping on draft in #marketing for send approval

samir: thanks — please update this thread when your item is done :thumbsup:
